summary.text: Michelle Salzman is a Republican member of the Florida House of Representatives for District 1, first elected in 2020.

paragraphs.text: According to the House's biographical page, Salzman served five years in the United States Army as a logistician and armorer and owns a small business.
Salzman holds an A.A.S. from Pensacola State College and a B.S.B.A. from the University of West Florida.
